ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.CALENDAR_ARTIFACTS: RESOLVED: UTC daily bars; weekday and holiday effects common to all names cancel in within-date ranks; ISO weeks; year stability gate.
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.CROSS_SECTIONAL_DEPENDENCE: RESOLVED: within-date permutation keeps each date cross-sectional target structure fixed; market-wide wick days only shift the intercept.
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.LIQUIDITY_SELECTION: RESOLVED: top-50 by pre-t volume; liquidity is both a permutation stratum and a control rank.
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.LISTING_AGE: RESOLVED: 35-day listing age (Sprint 04 rule) removes listing-day bars and first-month dynamics from predictors.
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.LOOKAHEAD: RESOLVED: predictor/universe/controls use d <= t-1; target uses d >= t; synthetic test mutates bars >= t and bars < t separately.
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.MECHANICAL_OHLC_IDENTITIES: RESOLVED: no shared bar; the target 2*RET term is removed by residualization; the synthetic test checks the identity.
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.OVERLAPPING_HORIZON: RESOLVED for primary: H=1 targets never overlap across dates. K=5 predictor windows overlap; handled by DEPENDENCE_GATE (HAC). H=5 secondaries overlap and are descriptive only.
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.RESEARCHER_DEGREES_OF_FREEDOM: RESOLVED: one primary variant chosen by outcome-free rules; every threshold, count and seed frozen here; secondary grid cannot decide.
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.RETURN_WICK_COUPLING: RESOLVED on both sides: target residualized on same-window return and range; predictor-side coupling (CLV vs trailing return) handled by CONTROL_GATE with trailing return, range and liquidity ranks.
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.SAME_BAR_CONTAMINATION: RESOLVED: disjoint windows. Residual adjacency (close(t-1) ~ open(t), bid-ask bounce) is diluted by K=5 and tested by ADJACENCY_GATE.
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.SURVIVORSHIP: RESOLVED: universe from the archive including later-delisted names; selection uses pre-t volume only; one-day target survival reported and capped.
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.TICK_SIZE_DISCRETENESS: DECLARED LIMITATION (card confounder 1): no tick-size data is catalogued; top-50 liquidity selection keeps daily ranges many ticks wide. No outcome-motivated price filter is added.
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.UNSTABLE_UNIVERSE: RESOLVED: constant N=50 on every valid date; no partial universes.

AGGREGATION.POOLED_STATISTIC: arithmetic mean of weekly statistics over valid weeks (equal weight per week)
AGGREGATION.WEEK: ISO week, Monday 00:00 UTC to Sunday 23:59:59 UTC; a decision date belongs to the week containing it
AGGREGATION.WEEKLY_STATISTIC: arithmetic mean of the valid daily rho_t in the week (equal weight per day)
AGGREGATION.WEEK_VALID: at least 5 valid decision dates in the week
AGGREGATION.YEAR_OF_WEEK: calendar year of the week Monday

CARD_VERBATIM.BASELINE_OR_NULL: Baseline: cross-sectional model of WICK_RESID rank using trailing return rank, trailing range rank and log quote-volume rank only. Null: 1000 within-date permutations of CLV ranks inside quote-volume terciles, each producing the same mean weekly rank-correlation statistic.
CARD_VERBATIM.CAUSAL_OR_STRUCTURAL_STORY: A daily bar that closes near its low, leaving an upper wick, reflects intraday rejection of higher prices. Plausible sources are supply that appears on rallies from stale holders, inventory-heavy makers, or unlock-related distribution. If that supply is name-specific and persists for days, a name's trailing close-location value (CLV) should predict the shape of its future intraday path, measured as wick asymmetry. The prediction should hold even after removing the part explained by the same-window close-to-close return. This is a question about path morphology on a panel, not about relative returns.

DATA_REQUIRED.OBSERVABLE: Daily open, high, low, close and quote volume per symbol, plus listing and delisting status and pinned exclusion lists

CARD_VERBATIM.EXPECTED_IMPLEMENTATION_COST: Low. The work is daily-panel feature construction, residualization and within-stratum permutation.
CARD_VERBATIM.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Opens or closes the morphology branch of the cross-sectional panel with a single frozen test that is orthogonal to the return target D13 already tested.
CARD_VERBATIM.FALSIFIER: The claim fails if any of the following holds: (1) the mean rank correlation between CLV and WICK_RESID lies within the central 95 percent of the stratified permutation null; (2) yearly correlations share the pooled sign in fewer than 3 of 5 years; (3) the association disappears once trailing return rank is included.
CARD_VERBATIM.FUNCTION: Cross-sectional rank association between trailing CLV rank and subsequent residual wick-asymmetry rank, with liquidity and trailing-return controls
CARD_VERBATIM.HORIZON: H daily bars following each 00:00 UTC decision time
CARD_VERBATIM.MAIN_CONFOUNDERS: (1) Tick-size discreteness quantizes CLV for low-priced names. (2) Pegged or stablecoin-like pairs; these are excluded via the pinned lists. (3) Bars on listing and delisting days. (4) Wick asymmetry is mechanically correlated with the same-window return, and the residualization depends on functional form. (5) Universe-wide wick days driven by market-level moves.
CARD_VERBATIM.MECHANISM: Persistent name-specific rejection of intraday price levels leads to predictable subsequent wick asymmetry, beyond what return explains
CARD_VERBATIM.MECHANISM_DISTANCE_ARGUMENT: D13 and GV0CAL-C005 target close-to-close relative returns. Here the target is explicitly orthogonalized to the same-window relative return, so it measures where within the daily range trading takes place, not direction. D3 characterizes the unconditional BTC path and is not a conditional panel test.
CARD_VERBATIM.NAME: Persistence of intraday wick morphology across the Binance spot USDT cross-section
CARD_VERBATIM.NO_LOOKAHEAD_RULE: The universe at t is the top-N names by trailing 30-day quote volume, computed only from bars closed at or before t. It includes names that were later delisted. Exclusion lists apply only from their pinned publication dates. Outcome-window variables enter only the target-side residualization and never the predictor. All parameters are frozen before any target is computed.
CARD_VERBATIM.OBSERVABLE: CLV_i,t is the mean over the last K daily bars closed at or before t of (2C - H - L)/(H - L), excluding bars with H equal to L. It is ranked cross-sectionally within the eligible universe at t.
CARD_VERBATIM.PRIMARY_TARGET: Weekly mean Spearman correlation between CLV rank and WICK_RESID rank. WICK_RESID_i is the residual of the sum over the next H daily bars of [log(H/O) - log(O/L)], after a cross-sectional regression on the same-window relative log return and log range.
CARD_VERBATIM.WHAT_NULL_WOULD_ELIMINATE: Eliminates persistence of daily-bar morphology as a panel mechanism. Any panel structure would then have to reside in returns rather than in path shape.
CARD_VERBATIM.WHAT_POSITIVE_WOULD_TEACH: That intraday rejection of price levels is persistent at the name level, a structural property of path shape that is distinct from momentum.
CARD_VERBATIM.WHY_NOT_A_RESCUE: It is not a re-horizoning of D13. The predictor is intraday bar shape rather than formation return, and the target removes the return component D13 tested.

ANTI_RESCUE: no horizon, lookback, N or universe change after the run
no changed liquidity control or strata
CLASSIFICATION_RULES.NO_P_VALUE_ALONE: A nominal P_TWO_SIDED <= 0.05 alone never yields PROMISING_PROTOTYPE.
CLASSIFICATION_RULES.NO_TRADING_LANGUAGE: No profitability, cost or tradability claim is made or tested.
PRECEDENCE: IDENTITY_OK false (any preflight, digest, ledger-byte or integrity failure) -> INVALID_DISCOVERY
STATISTICAL and DIRECTION and TEMPORAL and CONTROL and DEPENDENCE and ADJACENCY gates all true -> PROMISING_PROTOTYPE
otherwise -> NO_USEFUL_STRUCTURE (REASONS lists every failed gate; OPPOSITE_DIRECTION_OUTSIDE_NULL when significant with the wrong sign)
CLASSIFICATION_RULES.TAXONOMY: Reuses the canonical discovery taxonomy (scripts/research/discovery_sprint_04/common.py classify_from_summary; Sprint 01-04).

VOCABULARY_MAP.NO_USEFUL_STRUCTURE: NO_EVIDENCE; CONTRADICTED when REASONS contains OPPOSITE_DIRECTION_OUTSIDE_NULL

CONTROL_DEFINITIONS.CONTROLLED_STATISTIC: partial rank correlation: X = resid(rank CLV ~ [1, rank TRAIL_RET, rank TRAIL_RANGE, rank QV30]); Y = resid(rank WICK_RESID ~ same); rho_ctrl = Pearson(X, Y). These are the card BASELINE controls (trailing return, trailing range, log quote-volume ranks).
CONTROL_DEFINITIONS.LIQUIDITY: rank of QV30 within A_t (rank of log QV30 is identical)
CONTROL_DEFINITIONS.NO_WINSORIZATION: No winsorization or standardization; ranks after residualization.
CONTROL_DEFINITIONS.RANGE_WIN: sum over target bars of ln(high_b / low_b)
CONTROL_DEFINITIONS.RET_WIN: sum over target bars of ln(close_b / open_b)
CONTROL_DEFINITIONS.TARGET_SIDE_RESIDUALIZATION: WICK_RESID = OLS residual of WICK on [1, RET_WIN, RANGE_WIN] across A_t (card: residual after a cross-sectional regression on the same-window relative log return and log range; the intercept makes raw and relative returns equivalent)
CONTROL_DEFINITIONS.TRAIL_RANGE: sum over predictor bars t-K..t-1 of ln(high_b / low_b); ranked within A_t
CONTROL_DEFINITIONS.TRAIL_RET: sum over predictor bars t-K..t-1 of ln(close_b / open_b); ranked within A_t

CARD_1.TEXT: mean rank correlation within the central 95% of the stratified permutation null

CARD_2.TEXT: yearly correlations share the pooled sign in fewer than 3 of 5 years

CARD_3.GATE: CONTROL_GATE fails when the controlled statistic is inside the central 95% of its own null or its sign differs from the pooled primary
CARD_3.TEXT: association disappears once trailing return rank is included

FEATURE_DEFINITIONS.BAR_CLV: CLV_b = (2*close_b - high_b - low_b) / (high_b - low_b), raw prices, exactly the card formula; undefined (skipped) when high_b == low_b
FEATURE_DEFINITIONS.PREDICTOR_CLV_K: CLV_i,t = arithmetic mean of CLV_b over bars b in {t-K, ..., t-1} with high_b > low_b (card: mean over the last K daily bars closed at or before t, excluding H == L). Day t itself is excluded.
FEATURE_DEFINITIONS.PREDICTOR_RANK: rank of CLV_i,t within A_t, average ranks for ties, 1-based
FEATURE_DEFINITIONS.WELL_FORMED_BAR: all of open, high, low, close finite and > 0; quote volume finite and >= 0; low <= open <= high and low <= close <= high

GATES.ADJACENCY_GATE: pooled statistic of the same predictor and universe against the H=1 target starting one day later (bar t+1) has the same sign as the primary. Resolves close(t-1)/open(t) adjacency coupling: an effect that exists only in the adjacent bar is not persistence.
GATES.CONTROL_GATE: controlled pooled statistic P_TWO_SIDED <= 0.05 and same sign as the pooled primary
GATES.DEPENDENCE_GATE: Newey-West t of the weekly primary series (valid weeks in chronological order), Bartlett kernel, lag 4 (= floor(4*(T/100)^(2/9)) for T = 250..260), |t| >= 1.96 and same sign. Resolves the serial dependence the within-date null ignores (overlapping K=5 predictor windows).
GATES.DESIGN_GATES_ONLY_NARROW_SUPPORT: DEPENDENCE_GATE and ADJACENCY_GATE are pre-outcome adversarial-review additions. They can only turn a would-be support into NO_USEFUL_STRUCTURE; they cannot rescue anything.
GATES.DIRECTION_GATE: pooled primary < 0. Persistence means low trailing CLV (upper-wick rejection) predicts high future upper-minus-lower excursion from the open (see TARGET_DEFINITION.ALGEBRA). A significant positive value is reported as OPPOSITE_DIRECTION_OUTSIDE_NULL and is never re-read as support for a different mechanism.
GATES.STATISTICAL_GATE: P_TWO_SIDED <= 0.05 for the primary pooled statistic

HORIZON.APPROACH: A: one primary variant nominated by an ex-ante rule; the other seven card variants are a descriptive secondary grid that can never change the classification.
RULE: N=50: the only card value that gives a constant cross-section size on every decision date. Outcome-blind universe metadata shows fewer than 100 eligible names until 2020 H2 (min 82), so N=100 would mean a time-varying or missing universe.

H=1: target windows of consecutive decision dates do not overlap, so each target bar is used once per name. H=5 overlaps 4/5 between consecutive dates, which the within-date permutation null ignores. H=1 also keeps every target bar inside the final legal week.

K=5: the card claims PERSISTENT name-specific rejection, a multi-day state. K=1 makes the predictor the single bar adjacent to the target, where close(t-1) ~ open(t) microstructure coupling (bid-ask bounce) is strongest; K=5 dilutes that bar to 1/5 of the predictor.

MISSING_DATA.DENOMINATORS: every variant reports decision days, valid days, invalid days by reason, selected name-days and missing targets by reason
MISSING_DATA.PREDICTOR: any missing or malformed bar in t-K..t-1 makes the name ineligible at t (never imputed)
MISSING_DATA.SURVIVAL: Only the one-day (H=1) target survival is conditioned on, which is required to observe a target. Its rate is reported and capped by MAX_MISSING_TARGET_RATE.
MISSING_DATA.TARGET: missing bar, malformed bar, or a symbol final archive bar before 2024-12-31 (delisting-day bar) makes the target missing; the name leaves A_t for that date and is counted in MISSING_TARGET_BY_REASON

MULTIPLICITY.MULTIPLICITY_METHOD: One primary hypothesis at alpha 0.05 two-sided. The six gates are an intersection-union conjunction on that one hypothesis (all must pass), so no alpha inflation. The 7 secondary variants form a descriptive family with Holm adjustment and no decision role. Search-family accounting: GV0R01 generated 30 cards; generated cards are not market tests; this is executed test 1 of SF-GENERATOR_V0-GV0R01 and is recorded in docs/research/SCIENTIFIC_TEST_LEDGER.json before any outcome.
MULTIPLICITY.NOT_EXPLORATORY_RELABEL: Nothing in this design is labelled exploratory to avoid accounting.

NAME: Persistence of intraday wick morphology across the Binance spot USDT cross-section

NULL_MODEL.CONTROLLED_NULL: the same permutation indices applied to X = resid(rank CLV ~ controls) (Kennedy 1995 residualized-predictor permutation)
NULL_MODEL.FIXED: rank(WICK_RESID), the analysis set, strata, valid-day and valid-week masks
NULL_MODEL.NAME: within-date quote-volume-tercile permutation (card)
NULL_MODEL.NULL_STATISTIC: for draw b: daily rho_t^b -> weekly means over the same valid days -> pooled mean over the same valid weeks
NULL_MODEL.PERMUTED: rank(CLV) values within each stratum (card: permutations of CLV ranks inside quote-volume terciles)
NULL_MODEL.P_VALUE: P_LOWER = (1 + #{null <= obs})/(B+1); P_UPPER = (1 + #{null >= obs})/(B+1); P_TWO_SIDED = min(1, 2*min(P_LOWER, P_UPPER)). The observed statistic is outside the central 95% of the null exactly when P_TWO_SIDED <= 0.05.
NULL_MODEL.SIDEDNESS: two-sided (card: central 95%), plus a separate direction gate
NULL_MODEL.STRATA: on each date, A_t is sorted by QV30 descending (ties by symbol) and split into 3 strata of sizes floor(n/3) boundaries: positions [floor(g*n/3), floor((g+1)*n/3)) for g = 0, 1, 2
NULL_MODEL.UNIT: independent permutation per decision date and per draw

OUTPUT_SCHEMA.WRITE_MODE: exclusive create; canonical JSON (indent 2, sorted keys, no NaN)

POINT_IN_TIME.BAR: A 1d kline for UTC day d opens at d 00:00:00.000 and closes at d 23:59:59.999. AVAILABLE_AT = d+1 00:00:00 UTC.
POINT_IN_TIME.DECISION_TIME: t = 00:00:00 UTC of decision day t
POINT_IN_TIME.EXCLUSIONS: Pinned name-only list (digest 35779ca5...). Each excluded symbol is a stablecoin/fiat base or a leveraged token, an intrinsic instrument identity known at its listing, so applying it on every date uses no post-t information. The card phrase about publication dates is satisfied: the list was pinned by the Sprint 04 freeze before any C013 computation.
POINT_IN_TIME.FEATURE_CUTOFF: predictor, controls, eligibility and universe use bars with d <= t-1 only
POINT_IN_TIME.LISTING_AGE: first archive bar day <= t-35 (archive starts 2019-12-01, so pre-archive listings qualify from 2020-01-05)
POINT_IN_TIME.NO_SAME_BAR: No bar enters both the predictor window (d <= t-1) and the target window (d >= t).
POINT_IN_TIME.TARGET_START: bar t+OFFSET (OFFSET 0 primary; 1 for the adjacency diagnostic)

POPULATION.ANALYSIS_SET: A_t = selected names whose target is valid. The date is valid only if |A_t| >= ceil(0.9 * N) (45 for N=50, 90 for N=100). All ranks and regressions use A_t.
ELIGIBILITY_AT_T: symbol not in the pinned EXCLUDED_SYMBOLS
bars t-K .. t-1 all present and well-formed
at least one of those K bars has high > low
POPULATION.NO_NEW_EXCLUSIONS: No exclusion beyond the pinned Sprint 04 list; no price, tick-size or volatility filter.
POPULATION.QV30: sum of quote_asset_volume over well-formed bars with day in [t-30, t-1]; missing or malformed bars contribute 0 (not traded)
POPULATION.SELECTION: Top N eligible names by QV30 descending; ties by symbol ascending. If fewer than N names are eligible the date is invalid (UNIVERSE_SHORT); no partial universe.
POPULATION.UNIVERSE: Binance spot USDT-quoted symbols in the frozen object ledger, including names delisted later (no survivorship filter).

PREFLIGHT.REFUSAL: execute refuses on any failed check; no partial run

PROTECTED_DATA_RULE.ENFORCEMENT: ledger keys outside 2019-12..2024-12 refused; any 2025/2026 row or day refused; decision days never require a bar after 2024-12-31

SECONDARY_GRID.N100_EARLY_DATES: dates with fewer than 100 eligible names are invalid for N=100 variants and are reported, not back-filled
SECONDARY_GRID.USE: descriptive parameter-robustness report (EDGE_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL section 11); each gets its pooled statistic and a 1000-draw permutation P_TWO_SIDED, with Holm adjustment across the 7

SOURCE.GOVERNANCE_STATE: CONSUMED (Memory Finalizer governance region state only; not scientific support)

TARGET_DEFINITION.ALGEBRA: Per bar, ln(H/O) - ln(O/L) = -ln(H/L) * CLVlog_b + 2 ln(C/O), where CLVlog uses log prices. Regressing on RET_WIN removes the 2*RET term; what remains is range-weighted future close location.
TARGET_DEFINITION.DAILY_STATISTIC: rho_t = Pearson(rank CLV, rank WICK_RESID) over A_t = Spearman correlation
TARGET_DEFINITION.WICK: WICK_i,t = sum over target bars b of [ln(high_b / open_b) - ln(open_b / low_b)] (card formula verbatim)

TIES: average ranks (1-based) for CLV, WICK_RESID and all control ranks; universe ties by symbol ascending; tercile ties by symbol ascending

TIME_RANGE.NO_EXTENSION: The panel is never extended; decision days that would need a bar after 2024-12-31 are not generated.
TIME_RANGE.WEEKS: 260 ISO weeks, Monday 2020-01-06 .. Monday 2024-12-23 (52 per year 2020..2024)

YEAR_STABILITY.PARTIAL_2019: not a year; December 2019 is warm-up only
YEAR_STABILITY.RULE: at least 3 of the 5 yearly statistics have strictly the same sign as the pooled statistic; a yearly value of exactly 0 does not share the sign; a pooled value of 0 fails
YEAR_STABILITY.YEARLY_STATISTIC: mean of valid weekly statistics whose Monday is in that year
